authority: User rejects Open as redundant and requires On hold to be a visual state, not a default exclusion. OmniFocus is an information-architecture reference, not imported domain behavior.
revision: Promote Tags to a first-class navigation destination alongside Projects.
Do not exclude On hold because it is on hold. Represent with a pause icon and English label.

observations: OmniFocus has task-oriented perspectives such as Inbox, Projects, Tags and Flagged.
Projects and Tags are useful distinct browsing entrances with a sidebar and outline.
Custom perspectives offer saved ways to view existing data.
official_reference.adopt: Navigation by Inbox, classification and chosen saved view, with selected list and inspector.
do_not_adopt: Grouped tags that duplicate an action
OmniFocus availability rules that hide on-hold items

custom_navigation: Perspectives as a separate section with exact saved names; use the same selected list and inspector rather than a second app mode.

layout.wide: Compact view rail; Projects/Tags expose selected classification list in their own context; main pane presents selected title and actions; inspector opens only on action selection. Avoid permanently showing all classification trees and empty inspector columns.
layout.narrow: View selector with Inbox/Projects/Tags/Flagged/History and Perspectives; Project/Tag selection appears before its action list; details open in the existing focused editor with Back. Classification list and action list are sequential screens when width requires it.

view_contracts.Inbox: Existing unfinished, project-unassigned scope. On hold is included. Defer inclusion remains the existing Inbox contract.
view_contracts.Projects: Top-level first-class entrance. Select an exact Project/path; show matching unfinished active and on-hold actions. No implicit active-only availability filter. Defer and include-descendants behavior is explicit and independent from on-hold state.
view_contracts.Tags: Top-level first-class entrance. Select exact Tag/path; show exact matches once, preserving action-tree relative order. Show Project context in rows where helpful. No tag inheritance or grouping-based action duplication.
view_contracts.Flagged: Both active and on-hold directly flagged actions included subject to the explicitly communicated Defer scope. Existing direct-only flags remain; on-hold is never a separate exclusion rule.
view_contracts.History: Completed and Dropped share one navigation entry, with All / Completed / Dropped controls. Distinct lifecycle labels remain; no data merge or removal.
view_contracts.Perspectives: Saved filter-only definitions govern exact matches and retain order. Excluding On hold requires an explicit saved status filter selected by the user; no hidden built-in intersection.
view_contracts.On hold: Pause icon plus On hold label, same readable action title contrast and selection/completion/flag access as active actions. Do not fade it to imply disabled or impossible. It is a persisted explicit status, not external observation or execution gating.

scope_notes: Reference navigation and visual hierarchy only; do not recreate the OmniFocus GTD/availability model.
Project/Tag display and selection are in this exploration; full catalog management remains separate.
Perspective selection and filter summary are primary. Create/edit/remove need their existing revision, preview, exact-request replay and Undo flow when later implemented.
Do not modify normal API/list_scopes merely to satisfy a UI label; the new classification entrances define explicit projection contracts.
Saved user names and descriptions remain exact; authored UI stays English.
Defer and lifecycle remain independent. Removing on-hold hiding does not itself remove parent Defer or date visibility behavior.

scenarios.given: Matching active and on-hold actions exist in the selected Project or Tag
scenarios.then: Both appear; on-hold has pause icon and On hold label, with readable title and ordinary controls
scenarios.counterexample: An implicit available/active-only filter hides the on-hold action.

scenarios.given: An on-hold action is project-unassigned or directly flagged
scenarios.when: The corresponding Inbox or Flagged view is selected
scenarios.then: On hold alone does not exclude it; any Defer restriction is visibly separate
scenarios.counterexample: Paused appearance also disables completion, editing or flagging.

scenarios.then: Its exact matching action appears once with Project context and preserved order
scenarios.counterexample: The app inherits tags from an action parent or duplicates matching rows.

scenarios.given: A user-selected saved view explicitly selects only active status
scenarios.then: On-hold actions are excluded by the visible user-authored filter; built-in classification views still include them
scenarios.counterexample: All perspectives silently impose active-only filtering regardless of definition.

scenarios.given: Completed and dropped records both exist
scenarios.then: Both appear with distinct status, while Completed/Dropped toggles filter matches without mutations
scenarios.counterexample: Dropped is relabeled Completed or deleted.

scenarios.given: Unsaved action details or an exact unknown write are retained
scenarios.when: The user changes Project/Tag/Perspective or display width
scenarios.then: The proposal remains reachable and recovery uses its original request; matching membership is not mistaken for existence
scenarios.counterexample: Classification selection clears a draft or retries an unknown write with a fresh ID.

short_recommendation: Open は削除し、Inbox / Projects / Tags / Flagged / History を入口にします。Perspectives は保存した絞り込みとして別セクションに置きます。On hold は隠さず、同じ一覧で pause アイコンとラベルで区別します。広い画面は選択一覧＋必要時の inspector、狭い画面は view selector→一覧→詳細にします。OmniFocus はこの構造の参考にし、availability・sequential・project state・flag inheritance は持ち込みません。
